impact: The test hardcodes datetime(2026, 9, 5) for the transaction and compares against utc_now() for the current budget month. Fails in October, November, etc. — anywhere outside September. Noise in the test suite that masks real failures. Fix: either freeze the clock with freezegun to September, or dynamically use utc_now().year/month in the fixture.
title: test_run_sync_reports_newly_crossed_thresholds_once fails every month that isn't September
